caseName: Texas Co. v. Hogarth Shipping Corp.
caseNameFull: The Texas Company v. Hogarth Shipping Corporation, Limited, Owner, etc.

opinions.text: October 25, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted. Mr. John W. Griffin for petitioner. Mr. John M. Woolsey for respondents.
